content.title: It's Saint Patrick's Day 2026 — all the lucky food deals and freebies to score today
content.text: It’s time to paint the city green, without spending tons of green. Beers, burgers and baked goods at cut-rate prices are on the menu — at local and nationwide hotspots alike — in celebration of St. Patrick’s Day 2026, Tuesday, March 17. Like pots of gold at the end of rainbows, major eateries are toasting the century-old Irish holiday with discounts and deals for revelers who are ready to kick up their heels, including the 150,000 marchers and 2 million spectators at NYC’s annual St. Patty’s Day parade. And they’re not just river-dancing the day away. Celebrants in the Big Apple and beyond are gearing up to eat, drink and be as merry as a leprechaun with his lucky charms, according to new data, from Numerator, a research firm. Following a survey of 5,300 US consumers, the authorities found that food (61%), alcoholic beverages (48%), and decorations (35%) are the top intended purchases for this year’s extravaganza. Beer is the most-beloved alcoholic beverage for St. Patrick’s Day drinkers (58%), with Irish beers such as Guinness or Smithwick’s favored by 44%, per the findings, which note that folks are hoping to save some dough while enjoying the festivities. “Most shoppers plan to spend less than $100 in their celebrations of the holiday,” wrote study authors, noting the 46% of Patty partiers on the hunt for “promotions, sales and coupons” ahead of the big day. “Two-thirds of them expect rising prices to have an impact on their shopping, driving shoppers to seek more deals or shop at different retailers for better prices.” Well, carousers, look no further. Here’s a list of the luckiest, yummiest Saint Patrick’s Day bargains, bar none. 7-Eleven It’s the luck of the Irish at participating 7-Eleven, Speedway and Stripes stores. In-store customers can get a limited-time St. Patrick’s Day Donut with white icing and finished with green shamrock sprinkles. Participating 7-Eleven, Speedway and Stripes stores has a special deal for customers this St. Paddy’s Day. 7-Eleven Plus, for one day only, enjoy $17 off $30+ orders with promo code “LUCKY7” on the 7NOW Delivery app. The luck carries on throughout the month with $1 Deals for 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members on sweet and salty favorites such as Snyder’s Mini Pretzels, Rice Krispies Treats, Snickers, and 7-Select Gummi Bears and Worms. Amazon If you’re planning to cook some good ol’ Irish staples at home this year, Amazon has a few affordable deals to help you out. Between now and March 17, customers can order dinner basics for under $10, including Russet potatoes, whole carrots, and green cabbage, as well as O’Donnell’s Corned Beef Round Flat for $2.99 per pound. Baked by Melissa Baked by Melissa has a festive, limited-edition cupcake lineup just for St. Paddy’s Day. The limited-edition assortments feature three festive flavors: limited-edition Lucky Charm cupcake, Electric Tie-Dye and Triple Chocolate Fudge. Baked By Melissa has limited-time offerings for St. Patrick’s Day. Baked by Melissa California Tortilla Get a free small order of chips and queso, chips & salsa, or chips on March 17. Dining in? Mention the secret password “Lucky Cheese” at checkout. Ordering online or in the app? Enter code “LUCKYCHEESE” at checkout. Get a free small order of chips and queso, chips & salsa, or chips on March 17 at California Tortilla. California Tortilla Carvel The ice cream company has its iconic Cookie O’Puss ice cream cake back for a limited time. Carvel’s Cookie O’Puss ice cream cake. Cinnabon Rewards members can get any size and any flavored lemonade for $1. Good Times Burgers & Frozen Custard: Wear green and get a free scoop of Irish Cream Frozen Custard on March 17. No purchase necessary; limit one per customer. The menu has limited-time dishes, including a Reuben Sandwich and Fish ’n Chips – available for dine-in only. The Green Turtle has a range of deals for St. Patrick’s Day. The Guinness Chocolate Stout Cake Schmear is infused with Guinness Draught and inspired by the rich flavors of Guinness Chocolate Cake. Through March 25, the Guinness schmear will be available at PopUp Bagels locations nationwide. Guinness is partnering with PopUp Bagels to introduce the Guinness Chocolate Stout Cake Schmear. Guinness x PopUp Bagels Plus, Guinness is supporting the hospitality industry with the return of the ‘Stache for Charity initiative, inspired by the iconic Guinness ‘stache. Fans are invited to grow one, draw one, sip one or throw one on, then share it on Facebook or Instagram using #GuinnessGivesBack and tag @GuinnessUS. For every qualifying post shared now through March 31, Guinness will donate $1 (up to $50,000) to the Tales of the Cocktail Foundation. Plus, every Tuesday in March, Rewards members earn double points on all orders. Jamba The March Monthly Mystery smoothie flavor, Luck of the Tropics, is available until March 31. Greens get a tropical twist with a blend of mangos, Greek yogurt and kale. The Lock of the Tropics smoothie is available until March 31. For bigger groups, there’s Corned Beef Sliders ($72.39), a tray of 24 snack-sized sandwiches with a mix of Reuben Sliders and Corned Beef & Swiss Sliders, and the St. Patrick’s Day Platter ($120.59-$144.79) with 10 corned beef and Swiss sandwiches on rye, served with chips, pickles, and condiments, available in both lighter and full portion options. Guests who wear green March 16-17 can receive a free Green O’riginal Glazed® doughnut. Krispy Kreme’s Original Glazed doughnut is going green for the holiday. Lucky Charms Sugar Cookies, Lucky Charms Treat Bars and Just Magical Marshmallows. There are also special collaborations with Crumbl Cookies and Cold Stone Creamery. All month long, Cold Stone Creamery and Lucky Charms will swirl cereal and marshmallows into signature ice cream creations for a St. Patrick’s Day-inspired treat. Marco’s Pizza Get $3 off any size Specialty Pizza, such as The Philly, Hawaiian Chicken, and the Deluxe (to get the deal, use code LUCKY). McAlister’s Deli Members of the McAlister’s Rewards loyalty program can get a $1 Lucky Lemonade with any entrée purchase. The limited-time offering is a lucky twist on McAlister’s classic lemonade, mixed with blue raspberry syrup and peach purée — and it’s also available by the gallon for anyone celebrating at home. McAlister’s Rewards members can get a $1 Lucky Lemonade with any entrée purchase. Also, there’s free delivery on Tuesdays, including on St. Patrick’s Day. Paris Baguette Members of the PB Rewards loyalty program get a free pastry with any beverage purchase on March 17. Cane’s signature freshly squeezed lemonade will turn a festive green and is served automatically with orders at no extra charge. Members of the Randy’s Rewards loyalty program get double points with each purchase of the limited-time donuts through March 17. Red Robin St. Patrick’s Day specials include $8 margaritas and $5 Coors Light pints and the Big YUMMM Deal menu has value meals starting at $9.99.
